__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Select the Prometheus data source containing the PGX scrape jobs

title: PGX | GB10 GPU & Host (Hardware Only)
description: NVIDIA GB10 hardware dashboard. Only pgx_dcgm and pgx_node_exporter. Monitors shared system memory (not GPU-only VRAM), GPU compute/thermals/power, CPU, disk, network, and telemetry availability.

options.content:
### NVIDIA GB10 · GPU and host telemetry
**CPU and GPU share physical system memory.** The memory graphs use Linux `node_memory_*` to estimate capacity and pressure for the **whole host**, not GPU-only VRAM or model-specific allocations. `Used ≈ MemTotal − MemAvailable` is a host capacity-pressure estimate.

**Prometheus jobs:** `pgx_dcgm` for supported GPU compute, temperature, power and clocks; `pgx_node_exporter` for unified memory, CPU, swap, disk and network. The dashboard excludes dedicated framebuffer, memory-clock, XID and ECC panels that were unavailable in your current export. The bottom panels show metric availability; missing is not the same as zero.

panels.title: 01 · At a glance · shared memory & GPU
Shared pool used
panels.description: Whole host CPU+GPU memory: Linux MemTotal−MemAvailable (approximate used). Not GPU-only usage.

panels.title: Shared pool available
panels.description: Linux MemAvailable estimates how much memory can be allocated without swapping; shared CPU+GPU memory pool.

panels.title: Shared pool capacity
panels.description: Linux-reported physical memory usable by the OS, not necessarily the marketing installed capacity.

panels.title: Unified memory in use
panels.description: 100×(1−MemAvailable/MemTotal). Includes all applications and the OS.

panels.title: GPU compute busy
panels.description: DCGM GPU utilization (if available). This is compute activity, NOT the fraction of memory used.

panels.title: GPU core temp
panels.description: DCGM GPU temperature when supported by exporter.

panels.title: DCGM scrape healthy
panels.description: 1=healthy; 0=failed. Scrape status does not guarantee every DCGM metric exists.

panels.title: Node scrape healthy
panels.description: 1=healthy; 0=failed.

panels.title: Host CPU busy
panels.description: Mean CPU busy fraction across cores.

panels.title: GPU power draw
panels.description: GPU power reported by DCGM; may not include total platform power.

panels.title: Shared memory used vs available
panels.description: OS-level memory accounting for the entire shared pool. Does not isolate GPU memory.

panels.title: Shared pool utilization (%)
panels.description: Capacity pressure: values approaching 100% indicate little reclaimable memory available; not a GPU allocation percentage.

panels.title: Shared memory composition (non-additive)
panels.description: Separate Linux memory categories; may overlap. Lines are NOT additive; do not sum them to estimate GPU memory.

panels.title: Swap consumption
panels.description: Swap pressure can indicate insufficient shared system memory. Swap being used is not itself proof of a GPU out-of-memory condition.

panels.title: Swap I/O (pages/sec)
panels.description: Linux page swap-in and swap-out events (pages/s), not bytes/s. Optional depending on node_exporter collectors.

panels.title: Major page faults per second
panels.description: Frequent major faults with low available RAM can suggest shared memory pressure. Includes the whole host.

panels.title: GPU compute utilization (%)
panels.description: Percentage GPU busy per DCGM, not GPU memory consumption.

panels.title: GPU core temperature (°C)
panels.description: GPU temperature as reported by DCGM. Absence of series means unavailable, not zero.

panels.title: GPU board power (W)
panels.description: DCGM-reported GPU power, not necessarily total PGX system power.

panels.title: GPU SM clock (MHz)
panels.description: The metric is reported in MHz: Grafana custom unit display below is set to MHz.

panels.title: GPU memory-copy / decoder engine activity (%)
panels.description: These are engine activity counters if supported; they do not represent framebuffer/VRAM allocation.

panels.title: GPU compute utilization · 5-minute average
panels.description: Smoothed 5-minute GPU busy percentage. A complementary view of sustained load rather than a repeat of the instantaneous power graph.

panels.title: CPU utilization by mode (%)
panels.description: CPU usage averaged across cores for each mode. Linux modes may not sum exactly to the primary busy panel.

panels.title: CPU per-core utilization (%)
panels.description: Per-core CPU busy; find single-core bottlenecks distinct from GPU saturation.

panels.title: Filesystem used (%)
panels.description: Excludes common virtual and container mounts. Uses bytes available to unprivileged processes.

panels.title: Filesystem space available
panels.description: Usable free space by filesystem and mount point.

defaults.max: Disk I/O in bytes/s by device. If the same physical storage appears in multiple device-mapper layers, displayed device series should not be summed.
Shows physical and Tailscale interfaces where exported; some traffic may appear at more than one network layer.

panels.title: Metric availability · Present ≠ nonzero reading
panels.description: 1 = series exists in Prometheus now, 0 = series absent. These are presence indicators, NOT measurements. Missing GPU metrics are not silently displayed as zero.

panels.title: DCGM metric inventory · series count by metric name
panels.description: Lists exported DCGM metric names and the number of time series for each. A value of 1 means one matching series, NOT 1 byte or 1 billion. Table unit explicitly set to none.

panels.title: Why no framebuffer / ECC / memory clock panels?

options.content:
- **GB10 unified memory:** no dedicated VRAM framebuffer capacity exists for conventional `DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED`/`FB_FREE` graphs. Host memory is shared by CPU and integrated GPU; `node_memory_*` indicates combined pressure only.
- **Omitted, not replaced with zeros:** framebuffer used/free, framebuffer %, GPU memory clock, XID last code, uncorrectable ECC. These were not emitted by your exporter or returned `N/A` from `nvidia-smi` in the observed checks. They may be absent due to hardware capabilities, driver version, or collector configuration.
- **A DCGM target may be `UP` while specific metrics are unavailable.** The table above lists which metrics actually exist. Count values are the *number of matching series*, not measured values. A `1.0B` display in a stat panel can reflect inappropriate Grafana unit formatting.
- **Want GPU-only allocations?** Linux shared memory cannot distinguish CPU vs GPU allocations. That requires additional process-level NVIDIA/CUDA telemetry not provided by these three standard exporter jobs. No GPU-only usage is inferred here.

Built for one PGX GB10 node using `pgx_dcgm` and `pgx_node_exporter`.
